NY Class of 2030 Rankings Release

November 24, 2026
Prep Baseball NY Staff

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:04
Instaread

Prep Baseball New York closed out the fall with a full slate of events, providing another look at the state’s emerging talent before players shift their focus to offseason development. With the calendar turning toward winter, we now take an early look at New York’s Class of 2030.

Still at the beginning of their high school careers, this initial ranking highlights players already showing advanced tools, athleticism and impact potential, along with prospects whose physical projection points to significant long-term upside. As the class continues to develop, future updates will expand with additional names, data and in-game evaluations.

Early returns point to a deep and talented group, highlighted by impressive arm talent, dynamic two-way athletes and several players already flashing tools beyond their years. Below, we break down the Top 10 before unveiling the complete list of ranked prospects.

Maykel Jimenez SS / 2B / The Stony Brook School, NY / 2030

Rankings  OverallRank: 61 / POS: 19

5-foot-9, 184 lb switch-hitting SS with a strong, compact build and advanced actions throughout the profile. Premium arm strength at 89 MPH across the diamond. Offensively, produces a 102.6 MPH max EV, 89.7 MPH average, and 60% hard-hit rate, backed by 29.7 g rotational acceleration. Advanced defensive actions and explosive offensive traits make for a high-level middle-infield follow.

2030 SS Maykel Jimenez (The Stony Brook School) BUILD: 5-9, 170 EV: R: 101 / L: 92 @maykel_jimenez8 | #NYSGames https://t.co/ug9kt6iR2Y

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) July 2, 2026

 

 

Trey Jervis SS / RHP / Oneonta, NY / 2030

Rankings  OverallRank: 117 / POS: 39

Dynamic 2-way prospect with an athletic 6-foot-1, 180 lb frame. Runs a 6.73 60 and produces a 96.9 MPH max EV, 368-foot max distance, and standout 78.7 MPH max bat speed. On the mound, the FB reaches 83.9 MPH with multiple breaking-ball shapes. High-priority two-way follow with advanced athleticism and impact tools for the class.

2030 SS Trey Jervis (Oneonta) BUILD: 6-1, 180 EV: 97🧃 Big time juice through the middle of the field, cleared the LCF wall on swing #3💣 @ShooterHunt | #JRNYSGames https://t.co/MJYNdloYET

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 30, 2026

2030 Trey Jervis SS/RHP (Oneonta) BUILD: 6-1, 180 Athletic mover with hand speed. Executes fastballs to all quadrants with the ability to get swing and miss on all pitches. FB: 80-84 CB: 69-70 SL: 71-72 #JRNYSGames https://t.co/FTVXI08AWI

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 30, 2026

 

 

Teddy Thanopoulos OF / 1B / Poly Prep Country Day School, NY / 2030

Rankings  OverallRank: 179 / POS: 42

Projectable OF with an advanced 6-foot-3, 190 lb frame. Produces a 95.9 MPH max EV, 353-foot max distance, and 72.0 MPH max bat speed while showing an 81 MPH OF arm. Intriguing young outfield profile with present juice and considerable long-term power potential.

2030 OF/1B Teddy Thanopoulos (Poly Prep) Build: 6-3, 190 EV: 96 MPH 🚀 @ShooterHunt | @TeddyThanop44 https://t.co/0eJ6yFMg5u

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 18, 2026

 

 

Luke Domajnko RHP / SS / Victor Senior High School, NY / 2030

Rankings  OverallRank: 187 / POS: 32

Highly projectable 2030 RHP with a lean 6-foot, 157 lb frame. FB works 82-85, T85.6, playing up with 7.1 feet of extension, pairing with a sweeping CB and a heavy, low-spin CH. Advanced arm talent with a quality three-pitch foundation and considerable developmental runway.

’30 RHP Luke Domajnko Victor (NY) 6’0” 157 lbs Athletic build with plenty to like on the mound. Works with a clean operation and showed feel for a three-pitch mix, attacking the zone throughout. FB: 82-85 mph (T86)🔥 CB: 68-72 mph CH: 76-78 mph #JRNYSGames https://t.co/cT64bp8ElM

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 30, 2026

 

 

Tyler Sisto 1B / LHP / CBA-Syracuse, NY / 2030

Physical 2-way with advanced arm talent and an impressive three-pitch mix. FB works 82-84, T84.1 with up to 21.2” of ASR, pairing with a high-spin SL (2,507 RPM) and heavy fading CH. Adds an 86 MPH positional arm and 90.7 MPH max EV. High-priority young southpaw follow with advanced stuff for the class.

2030 1B/LHP Tyler Sisto (CBA-Syracuse) Toed the rubber and showed loose levers into FB T84. Above average secondary stuff for his age, spinning CB up to 2400+ RPM while flashing plus potential with the CH. FB: 82-83 T84 CB: 72-73 (2400+🔄) CH: 72-74 @TylerSisto2030 | #PBJFG26 https://t.co/O4hJQJbH9T

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) July 24, 2026

 

 

Erik Gomez-Medina OF / RHP / Eastridge Senior High School, NY / 2030

5-foot-10, 191 lb OF with a physical, strength-driven build. Shows advanced arm strength at 86 MPH from the OF and runs a 7.15 60. Offensively, produces a 94.8 MPH max EV, 85.8 MPH average, and 337-foot max distance. Arm strength and present offensive impact stand out early in the profile.

2029 OF/RHP Erik Gomez-Medina (Eastridge, NY) BUILD: 5-10, 178.1 lbs. Exit Velo: 95 #NYSGames https://t.co/AI51hPBQh7

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 25, 2026

 

 

Brooks Lewis LHP / OF / Poly Prep Country Day School, NY / 2030

6-foot-1, 150 lb LHP/OF with a lean, projectable build. FB works 78-80, T80.7 with natural ASR and 96% spin efficiency. The 69-70 MPH SL flashes advanced spin up to 2,442 RPM, complemented by a CH with vertical separation. Adds a 7.13 60 and 87.7 MPH max EV offensively. Intriguing young southpaw with quality pitch traits and substantial physical projection.

 

 

Jack Wills RHP / 3B / Bishop Ludden Junior Senior High School, NY / 2030

Projectable RHP/LHH 3B with a lean 6-foot, 158 lb frame. FB reaches 82.4 MPH with quality ride/run, pairing with a sweeping CB and a heavy CH averaging 1,030 RPM. Adds a 90.7 MPH max EV and 63.2% sweet-spot rate from the left side. Advanced pitch-shape diversity for the class with plenty of physical projection remaining.

2030 RHP/3B Jack Wills (Bishop Ludden) FB: 79-82 (2100) SL: 67-69, (2200+) SPLT: 70-74, (900-1100)🕳️ Ultra-projectable build with a loose, whippy arm and easy arm speed. Feel for an advanced three-pitch mix highlighted by plus movement traits. @prepbaseball | #PBJFG26 https://t.co/CAoguc83md

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) July 26, 2026

2030 RHP Jack Wills (Bishop Ludden) BUILD: 6-0, 155 EV: 91 gap to gap💥 #JRNYSGames https://t.co/GcTTdvHZdC

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) June 30, 2026

 

 

Jackson Hildebrandt LHP / OF / LaSalle Institute, NY / 2030

6-foot-7, 168 lb LHP/OF with rare length and significant projection. FB has progressed to 78-81, T80.7 with quality ride/run, averaging 18.0” IVB and -14.5” HM from 7.0 feet of extension. CH sits 74-75 with heavy fade at -17.5” avg HM. Earlier showed a low-70s CB. Unique young mound profile with size, angle, and movement traits.

2030 LHP/OF Jackson Hildebrandt (LaSalle Institute) BUILD: 6-7, 163.8 FB: 78-80 T81 CH: 73-75 Lengthy frame with tuned mechanics. Keeps the levers in synch and tunnels a FB/CH combo with deceptive arm-side action #NYFallID https://t.co/QadcOPkP8a

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) September 13, 2026

 

 

Caden Newman 3B / RHP / Ballston Spa, NY / 2030

Physical 2-way prospect with an advanced 6-foot-2, 190 lb frame. Shows an 83 MPH INF arm and a 95.1 MPH max EV with a 347-foot max distance. On the mound, the FB works 79-80, T80.4 with quality ride/run and pairs with CB/CH. High-upside two-way follow with significant developmental runway.

#PBJFG26 Follow 🆙 2030 3B/RHP Caden Newman (Ballston Spa) Moderate arm swing into a standard 3/4 slot with noticeable deception through release. FB T83 showed quality carry while generating S/M. Mixed in CH at 72-73 mph. FB: 79-82 T83 CH: 72-73 @PrepBaseball https://t.co/F6NevRksTB

— Prep Baseball New York (@PrepBaseballNY) July 27, 2026
